env.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
env.description: A Slack bot token (starts "xoxb-") with the chat:write scope — from a Slack app's own "OAuth & Permissions" page, installed to your workspace. The same bot token already used for a durable Slack approval notifier (core/http-notify-triggers/slack.ts), if one is already configured, works here too — same scope, same app.

env.name: SLACK_DEFAULT_CHANNEL
env.description: A channel ID (e.g. "C0123ABC456") or name (e.g. "#general") to post to when a call doesn't specify one explicitly. The bot must already be a member of this channel — invite it with /invite @<bot-name> in Slack first, or every call targeting this default fails. If this ability is installed under more than one agent and they should post to different default channels, set <AGENT_NAME>_SLACK_DEFAULT_CHANNEL instead (e.g. SUPPORT_SLACK_DEFAULT_CHANNEL for an agent named 'support') — that agent's own copy of post_to_slack checks its own override first and only falls back to this shared value when its override isn't set.
